item.title: Trump calls leaders to isolate Iran. And, SCOTUS backs Trump for now on mail-in voting
item.description: President Trump is calling on world leaders to join his economic war against Iran. And, the Supreme Court is backing the president for now on his order to restrict mail-in voting.

item.title: Can Trump's economic war against Iran do what airstrikes and negotiations couldn't?
item.description: What a new round of U.S. sanctions could mean after nearly six months of war with Iran — and years of economic pressure on the country.

item.title: DHS acknowledges the noncitizen numbers it touted on voter rolls were inflated
item.description: The Trump administration claimed to have found 250,000 noncitizens on the voter rolls in four states. But the agency's communications with states since then indicate that data was preliminary.
